_comment: Built-in one-click connectors. Merged under the platform catalog (platform-credentials.json): an entry there with the same id wins. Each stays disabled until the operator registers the provider's OAuth app and sets <PROVIDER>_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID / _CLIENT_SECRET (see .platform-oauth.env.example). redirect=relay means the OAuth app registers ONE callback, OAUTH_RELAY_BASE_URL/api/vault/oauth/relay/<provider>, instead of one per tenant.

credentials.name: Supabase
credentials.description: Connect your Supabase account, pick the project your app uses, and the project URL and keys are filled in for you.
credentials.unlocks: Your agent can work with your app's database. No keys to copy.

credentials.description: Let your builder read and push code in your GitHub repositories.
credentials.unlocks: Your builder can open, change and save the code for your site or app.

credentials.description: Let your builder manage your Netlify sites: deploys, environment variables and domains.
credentials.unlocks: Your builder can publish your site and set its environment variables.
